text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans",
    "Strong emphasis on security, open-source nature, and transparency",
    "Cross-platform compatibility (desktop, web, mobile, browser extensions)",
    "Reliable password syncing and autofill functionality",
    "Self-hosting option for advanced users",
    "Comprehensive and easily accessible feature set for diverse item types (logins, notes, cards, identities, SSH keys)"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to some competitors",
    "Learning curve for advanced features or organizational setup",
    "Occasional inconsistencies or minor bugs with autofill on certain websites or mobile devices",
    "Customer support for free users is primarily community-driven",
    "Mobile app experience, while functional, can sometimes be less intuitive than desktop",
    "Admin features for large organizations might be less robust or require more manual configuration"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "pro: 'Comprehensive feature set including 2FA, secure notes, and identity storage' was replaced by 'Comprehensive and easily accessible feature set for diverse item types (logins, notes, cards, identities, SSH keys)' because the note '[benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.' highlights the breadth and accessibility of item types.",
    "con: 'Learning curve for advanced features or initial setup for new users' was replaced by 'Learning curve for advanced features or organizational setup' because the notes '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.' and '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.' specifically point to friction related to organizational features rather than just general initial setup."
  ]
}

pros: Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans
Strong emphasis on security, open-source nature, and transparency
Cross-platform compatibility (desktop, web, mobile, browser extensions)
Reliable password syncing and autofill functionality
Comprehensive and easily accessible feature set for diverse item types (logins, notes, cards, identities, SSH keys)
cons: User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to some competitors
Learning curve for advanced features or organizational setup
Occasional inconsistencies or minor bugs with autofill on certain websites or mobile devices
Customer support for free users is primarily community-driven
Mobile app experience, while functional, can sometimes be less intuitive than desktop
Admin features for large organizations might be less robust or require more manual configuration
changed: pro: 'Comprehensive feature set including 2FA, secure notes, and identity storage' was replaced by 'Comprehensive and easily accessible feature set for diverse item types (logins, notes, cards, identities, SSH keys)' because the note '[benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.' highlights the breadth and accessibility of item types.

con: 'Learning curve for advanced features or initial setup for new users' was replaced by 'Learning curve for advanced features or organizational setup' because the notes '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.' and '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.' specifically point to friction related to organizational features rather than just general initial setup.
